title: fracreg — Fractional Regression Models
text: Ultimate Toolkit Fractional Data advanced R package estimation, specification analysis, interpretation fractional regression models. handles univariate proportions, participation rates, bounded data (0≤y≤10 \le y \le 1), providing state---art estimators single-part, two-part (hurdle), three-part (double-inflated) models.

title: fracreg — Fractional Regression Models
text: fracreg fully equipped handle complex data structures commonly found econometrics biostatistics: Univariate Fractional Models (fracreg): Fit standard 1-part models, hurdle 2-part models (mass 0 1), double-inflated 3-part models. Panel Data Models (fracregpd): Estimate fractional models fixed-T longitudinal data, supporting Correlated Random Effects (CRE) handle unobserved individual heterogeneity. Endogeneity & Heteroskedasticity (fracreghet): Correct endogenous covariates using Instrumental Variables (IV) via Control Function GMM approaches. Diagnostic Testing: Includes generalized goodness--functional-form (fracreg.ggoff), RESET (fracreg.reset), non-nested P-tests (fracreg.ptest). Analytical Partial Effects: Compute exact marginal effects model types (including 3-part composite effects) via Delta method using fracreg.pe().

title: Fractional Regression Models — fracreg-package
text: Provides comprehensive tools estimation specification analysis fractional regression models. supports univariate one-part, hurdle two-part, double-inflated three-part models. package also incorporates estimators panel data settings (CRE, GMM, QML) addresses unobserved heterogeneity endogeneity via correlated random effects control function approaches. supports various link functions, calculates average conditional partial effects analytically across model types, provides robust specification tests RESET, P test, GGOFF tests.
